nom: PEACH & LILY Pure Radiance Brightening Eye Cream

avis.titre: Bought once for myself then again for my Mom
avis.texte: Started using this eye cream about 3 weeks ago. It's so smooth and absorbs so nicely that I bought it for my Mom (along with the glass skin starter kit).

I've been using this for a couple weeks now and it seems to work nicely. It feels thick and luxurious but it's not too heavy for my eyes. It's good for using everyday, I don't worry about it being too much. A little goes a long way and this pot will last for a while even using daily.

avis.titre: Had to buy after a sample
avis.texte: Received a small sample and had to purchase a jar. I have tried numerous eye creams over the years, and this is the first I have ever had that actually showed a difference to lightening my dark circles. it is hydrating, but will absorb and I just love how it leaves my skin Cannot recommend enough!

avis.titre: Holy grail eye cream for very tired night shift RN
avis.texte: I typically have dramatic dark circles and eye bags that no product has helped, but this eye cream had made such a noticable difference that my sister (who recommended the product to me) could tell i had been using it. I would buy 1000 of them to hoarde for the rest of my life if I could.
This is my favorite eye cream that I have tired! I just bought 2 more jars during the 21 days of beauty. 10/10, must have !

I have a habit of rubbing my eyes when I don't have makeup on, and this has so far been a great help with keeping my under eyes hydrated. I think I've seen an improvement in the lines under my eyes as well!
Very hydrating - used day & night. This product did not help with dark circles

Surprised because i love so many of their other products, but this one is just okay. Not as hydrating as I needed and my eyes felt dry as the day went on. There are more affordable eye creams that do more than this.
Absorbs fast and works well under makeup, or alone on no makeup days.
I felt it only hydrated and nothing else. Did nothing for any dark areas.

I am slowly working my way through changing from my usual brand to Peach and Lily. This eye cream is one product I will be definitely repurchasing. Light on the skin, it is improving the texture and lessening the dark circles. One of, if not the best, eye creams I have used.

avis.titre: YES, I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I have had black marks under my eyes for about 4 years now. I have tried everything. I went and got a free sample for my birthday and OMG. I only used it for 3 days and woke up this morning and the dark spots I can barely see. I was so excited.
I love adding this eye cream in my nightly routine. Feel like it makes me look more energized. A little goes a long way. Would definitely recommend.
My under eyes look rejuvenated! Love the feel of the product on my skin. Highly recommend!
Love this! A lot of times for work I have to be there early, so I usually dont wear makeup. But this helps so much and brightens!
Im very happy with this eye cream i feel it is a little too expensive it is a small container but the quality is reflective and the container lasted me a while
Absorbs quickly, non-greasy, and gentle on sensitive skin. Giving enough hydration without causing irritation or allergic reactions. Good for daily use!

This eye cream is hydrating, but that's about all it did for me. It keeps my makeup from creasing under my eyes and helps my under eye area feel more hydrated, but it didn't do anything in terms of making my dark circles look better or brightening my under eyes. I like that it doesn't have any harsh ingredients that would irritate my eyes. I may purchase again in the future, but will look for something more effective for now.
Its light weight on the skin! It has help brighten my under eye circles and visible lines!
I really like this eye cream ! It brightens my eyes and absorbs easily.

As someone with dry under eyes and dark circles I hated the way makeup would settle into my lines. I put it on and my eyes look more awake. I do not have to wear as heavy layer of concealer. It not only brightens but also hydrates.
I just turned 34 and found my first wrinkle so I purchased this in hopes to slow down that process. So far my eyes look much better and more awake.
It has a great texture & goes on smooth. I love the way it feels. Works really well.

This eye cream is lovely! Deeply moisturizing but not greasy. I have dry eyes & often wake up with swollen, puffy eyelids. Putting this on makes a noticeable difference to the color and puff, as well as smoothing out my deep purple underyes. A possible downside is that for sensitive eyes, the cream could irritate them - I did experience that once, although that could have been down to other factors, as I haven't had issues since. But in general, this cream brightens beautifully & feels comfortable.

I have been using this eye cream for a while now and it really helps brighten my eye area, especially in the mornings. It keeps my under eye so moisturized, I feel like it really helps with the fine lines.

This is my second time purchasing - it's such a lifesaver for dark circles and puffiness. It's a great base for cream eyeshadow also. It feels so nourishing and works well in several different seasons/climates (super humid, very dry, cold, etc. ) I love everything about this eye cream except that it does its de-puffing job SO well that my eyes water a little bit after application sometimes (no, I'm not getting it in my eye haha!) and I just have to be mindful about wearing waterproof mascara with it. I wish it came in more hygienic packaging but also I just love little glass jars.
I'm not someone with sensitive skin and not allergic to anything. However, this caused the skin around my eyes to get a red, stinging, rash that got swollen and wrinkled and flaky.

I rarely write reviews for products. I had very dark circles under my sensitive eyes. I have tried caudalie, tatcha, roche, and many other products with no change to my circles. This eye cream has reduced them and now I barely need concealer or a color corrector. Highly recommend this and P&L in general!
The Pure Radiance Brightening Eye Cream is a perfect balance of lightweight moister and brightening.

Context: Mid-30s, no significant wrinkles in the skin around the eyes yet. A few fine lines if you're looking extremely close. Not a daily eye makeup-wearer. *Very* faint partial undereye circles (from poor sleep habits). This is a good nighttime eye cream! I like how dense it is - a dab is all that's needed in my routine. I had run out of my previous eye cream (CosRX) and was recommended P&L by a friend, so I gave this eye cream a shot during the end-of-year sale. After ~2 weeks of being without an eye cream, the P&L did appear to immediately undo some of the visible dryness & very fine lines that were starting to appear without my nighttime eye moisturiser. I haven't noticed other changes, but wasn't expecting anything huge (my very light undereye dark areas are primarily influenced by sleeping habits, which P&L unfortunately can't fix for me). This cream has a satisfying texture to it, and it applies & spreads easily without any sticking or pulling at the delicate skin of the eye area. I have not experienced any breakouts if I accidentally spread the cream too far (ex, up to the browbone or over into the bridge of my nose, which has happened with other eye creams). I would repurchase this cream.

it dose wonder's. and I have definitely noticed a difference. I typically have suken in purple eyes making me look like I always have black eyes. Well not anymore. my eyes have never looked better. The purple has gone and my eyes definitely look brighter. I have only been using it for about 3 weeks and 1 time every day. A little goes a long way.

I love peach and lily products, i have a whole set of skincare from this line and my face loves this so much. I will keep reordering skincare from this shop. I have shiny and glassy skin. Just need to be consistent. This eye cream is the best one ive tried so far. Im not a fan of eye creams because i think they never work. But this one is good
Hydrating cream I use twice a day. Not greasy and heavy feeling. Would buy again
I was using the retinol eye cream but decided to give this a try. It definitely seems to brighten my under eye circles and I'll keep using it.
This is a nice basic for daytime care of the skin around my eyes. A little caffeine helps perk things up when you're looking tired, and the formula doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.
I returned this item. Did not work because of sensitive eyes and made them run continuously. I did love the texture however- creamy.

I'm on my second jar of this eye cream and it really is a great value for your money. I know it's marketed as a brightening cream but it ALSO is stacked with several ceramdies for the barrier AND a bunch of peptides for firmness. I hate when brands claim certain indgredients but it's such a low amount. This eye cream gives tons of peptides and allll of the ceramides and no, they're not just sprinkled in at the bottom of the ingredient list haha. It feels very moisturizing and nourishing but still pretty lightweight.
Super hydrating, a little goes a long way - my favorite to use in the AM!

I got this while it was on sale. I have dark circles and when using this product for a few weeks I didn't notice a difference with under eye darkness. I decided to keep it because it does feel nice and moisturizing. A little goes a long way.

I rarely write reviews. I have dark hereditary circles and very sensitive eyes. I have tried so many eye creams, from caudalie to tatcha, and this is the first one that has started to fade my circles and does not bother my eyes. I barely need color corrector anymore. Highky recommend!

Got a free sample in a gift with purchase, burns so bad and dried out the skin around my eyes. I have relatively normal skin and very rarely have reactions from products. I would throw this straight in the trash, even if it was free.
This worked well for me and did not irritate my skin or burn my eyes
I love this cream, it brightens and smooths without clogging pipes and feeling heavy!

I have been using Peach & Lily products for about two years now. I have loved every product I've tried. I already had a large jar of eye cream from another brand that was expensive, and I wanted to use it up first before trying Peach & Lily Pure Radiance Eye Cream. I finally tried it about 6 or 7 weeks ago and I love it! It's so moisturizing without feeling greasy. I can continue with my usual eye makeup routine within a couple minutes of applying the eye cream. No waiting for it to completely dry. I feel like my eyes stay moisturized all day!

If nothing else, this has the most lovely, comforting texture of any eye cream I've used. It adds lasting moisture around my eyes, which tend to feel a bit dry even after regular face moisturizer. Not sure why there's no mention of all the peptides in this formula; that's the main reason I bought it, aside from the extra moisture.
I haven't been using it long enough to tell if it helps with puffy eyes.The moisturizing aspect is great, though.
Even when I only get three hours of sleep my eyes look rested with this eye cream. It is very hydrating for my under eyes and preps them nicely for makeup.
I usually love Peach and Lily, but this eye cream is VERY drying. I would not recommend thia product.

I have been loving the Pure Radiance Brightening Eye Cream! I use it ever morning and appreciate the way it makes me look awake and ready for the day (even when I haven't had my coffee yet)! I've noticed the dark circles under my eyes lightening and just feel better about my aging eye area overall. Definitely recommend!

I've been using this eye cream now for several weeks and I do like the texture and how well it absorbs. My eye area feels hydrated, even at the end of the day. I haven't yet noticed any lightening of the dark circles, but I'm sure time will tell.
This is a good cream but not sure if it really brightens. Have not used long enough so potentially but did not see any noticeable difference from the other eye creams I've used
It really works. It brightens, tightens and depuffs. Worth every penny and more

avis.titre: Peach & LILY never let's us down
avis.texte: I've been a user of Peach & Lily products for over a year now, and I truly love their products including this new eye cream, I noticed instantly that my under eye's looked brightened and depuffed and I love that the product is not too thick so its easier to apply the product.
Already noticing a difference under my eyes - brighter, less puffy and overall more radiant. I love the way it feels and look forward to putting it on every night!

avis.titre: Wanted to love but it made me break out
avis.texte: I LOVE this brand normally. I am a ginger with very sensitive skin and most of this brand works wonders. However, this product made me break out around my nose where the bridge of my glasses rests. This was not a problem before I started using this product and the pimples disappeared two days after I stopped using it. So I guess my advice would be this: If you have sensitive skin, this brand in general is wonderful. However, be careful with this product. Especially if you wear glasses every day.
This is one of the best eye creams I've used. Puffiness.. gone.. not heavy, little goes a long way. Eyes look refreshed.
My first time trying this product and I can see a difference in my dark circles already!

This stuff is creamy and hydrating, it seems to de-puff short term, but I haven't seen lasting effects yet. It's been a few weeks so hopefully over time it will show a lasting difference in my puffy eyes.
Spreads and absorbs well. My under eyes are so hydrated now and my makeup looks much better.

I've only been using the radiance brightening cream for just about two weeks and I already notice a difference . I love the way it feels on my skin; a silky thick texture that absorbs quickly and not too heavy leaving my eyes feeling refreshed
This product is worth every penny!! I have watched my dark eye circles disappear in 3 days!! It also has a lot of product and should last for a long time!
Does exactly what the packaging says it will do for my skin. Hope anyone else would have the same fantastic results. Been using for about 60 days.
Been using this product for a few weeks, makes my eyes look younger and my skin feel nice.
I often see no results with eye creams, but not with this one ! After a few days, it brightened my dark circles, and I feel like my eyes are less puffy in the morning.

avis.titre: Average, nothing to report. Only sadness :(
avis.texte: Okay so I'm not sure who the 5 people are that said this stuff is a game changer but I've been using it for weeks after a store associate talked me into it and I've seen no results. I'm not 18 nor did I get lucky with skin. I have eye oldness even though I've been faithful to good face care my entire life. This is the 3rd eye cream I have ever bought as I seek the holy grail of eye creams. 40 years old, ex smoker & 3 kids (one is 6 months!) and I have been eating better and drinking more water so if there was going to be a change under the eyeballs, 3 weeks in, I would have seen it by now. Using 2x a day.

I'm in my late 30s, and I've never reviewed an eye cream before, but this eye cream truly lives up to it's claims! I've recently been dealing with puffy/dark eyes due to allergies, along with having fine lines. I've been searching for an eye cream that will help with the puffiness and dark circles, without sacrificing moisture for my fine lines. The first day I tried this eye cream, the skin around my eyes was so much brighter and lost the puffiness. It is very moisturizing, and I have no trouble applying makeup over it a few minutes after applying the cream.

Peach & Lily works. It does what it says, which shouldn't be too much to ask for in skin-care products, but it is apparently. Well, Peach & Lily thankfully didn't lie. Finally a product that helps the skin.
I really like this eye cream, I feel like I have seen a difference using this consistently
It's amazing puffs up my sunken eye bags . Look like I revived
It's okay, I am still leaning more towards the other eye cream I was previously using. This cream burns my eyes when they water. So I have to make sure I don't get it too close to them.
I've only been using this for a few weeks but it appears to have helped decrease the under eye puffiness. I looks more awake and vibrant and smoother texture under eyes.

avis.titre: Product was great. Subscription process needs improvements.
avis.texte: I'm never disappointed by Peach & Lily products. Their Subscription Process needs improvements. Most companies I have subscriptions with will notify me by text and email before my subscription item is about to ship. This gives me a chance to change the delivery date if I'm not ready for a new shipment yet. This company does NOT do this. They also confirm your order a day before it's supposed to reship. For example if my reorder date is March 3rd, they push the order through on March 2nd which can also be a problem if I'm not ready for it to reship. The last time this happened to me I emailed to company and asked them to cancel the order explaining I wasn't ready for a new shipment yet and they never responded to my email and just shipped it out the next day anyways.

I never leave reviews. Ever. But i got this as a sample with another purchase and almost threw it away because ive tried all the eye creams and theh do nothing. But THIS :') my eyes have been SO dark since having my daughters because i havent had a full nights sleep in years and this completely reversed that. I ran out a couple weeks ago and could cry that im right back to where i was 🤣 ill be purchasing the very moment i have the money for it since its a bit procey. But made me feel a lot closer to 20 again instead of 30

avis.titre: Pure Radiance Brightening Eye Cream review
avis.texte: I use this product instead of the retinoic eye cream now, because it significantly depuffs, brightens, and firms my eye sockets (1st 👁️ pic is before; 2nd 👁️ pic is after). Before the both the retinoic acid and pure radiance eye creams, I was using Lancôme's eye cream, which was effective, but SUPER expensive ($95 + tax), so I'm glad I've found a cheaper but equally effective alternative!

I'm loving this eye cream so far. I have not noticed a major difference in the color under my eyes, but I don't think any eye cream will actually fix that. What I look for is something to make my under eyes feel hydrated and something that is easy to apply. I sometimes find with thick creams that check the hydration box, it is difficult to spread them or really get into the skin. Or creams that do spread well don't leave me feeling hydrated. This eye cream does both and a little goes a long way!

I absolutely love this eye cream! It has a very nice texture and instantly makes the skin around my eyes feel hydrated. I have dark circles under my eyes that I have never been able to reduce the appearance of. I have been using this eye cream for a few weeks now and have noticed that they have started to lighten and make my eyes more bright.

avis.titre: Pure Radiance Brightening Eye Cream- Love it!!!
avis.texte: This product works so well on my puffing early morning under eye bags!
Works great. It will probably last a long time because I only use a little.
This cream is nice and thick and spreads over the skin evenly. This looks nice on the skin.
The eye cream has a really nice consistent it is not too thin. It feels like it gives you a lot of moisture. I am using it in the morning and in the evening. I am very happy with it.

I usually have bad luck with eye creams; they tend to leave my eyes red and irritated. This eye cream literally changed the game for me. Its hydrating, calming, smoothing, and I find my makeup sits beautifully on top of it! This eye cream is now a permanent addition to my skincare routine!

This cream is such a treat to use on the delicate skin around your eyes. It helps make your skin look a bit more fresh and you can feel the moisture. I was so excited to buy this product when it launched. Love the quick delivery and service that you always get with Peach & Lily!
This is a very nice eye cream. It's light and absorbs in easily. My eyes depuff and the skin brightens up after every use.
Absorbs quickly, non-greasy, and gentle on sensitive skin. Giving enough hydration without causing irritation or allergic reactions. Good for daily use!

avis.titre: This eye cream is a game changer
avis.texte: I noticed a difference the first time I used it and instantly purchased two more for back ups! I do not ever want to run out!

I have a baby at home and we are going through an intense sleep regression at the moment. This eye cream came out at the perfect time and now my under eye area is visibly brighter and more hydrated looking, so while I may not be getting great sleep, I at least look like I am.
Within only two days I noticed a difference under my eyes. Skin looks much healthier and brighter. Will definitely be adding to my daily routine

I was a little surprised how small the jar was, but a little goes a very long way. I can't say after a week I feel like it does a *ton* for dark circles, but but it's super hydrating and glides on without being greasy. It's nice before makeup application.
I have very sensitive skin, especially around my eyes, and this does not irritate me skin at all. It's very soothing and brightening.
I have very sensitive skin, especially around my eyes, and this does not irritate at all. Love the smoothing and brightening effect and it is the perfect prep for under eye concealer.
Love this eye cream! I really see a difference in my eyes. They seem brighter and healthier!
